name: HelpHarbor
what_it_does: An embeddable help center for small web apps. Write answers in Markdown, and HelpHarbor serves a searchable FAQ panel, a floating help button, and contextual tooltips that open the right article on the right page.
target_user: Solo builders who get the same support questions over and over and have no support team.
integrations: GitHub repo as the article source
strengths: Articles live in a GitHub repo, so the help content ships with the code.
Contextual tooltips open the right article for the page the user is on.

agent_observations.note: would_use sits at 0.43. Reviewers said they would only open it once they were already stuck. The product serves users after they are inside the app and confused. It answers questions. It does not introduce the product. It shares two tags with FirstStep (tooltips, embeddable-widget) but its core is help-center, not onboarding.
